tools.name: skew_get_capabilities
tools.description: Return Skew's supported assets, 11 payoff names, collateral rails, trade lanes, profile counts, and MCP agentGuide. Call this immediately after skew_get_signer_info so the agent chooses Instant RFQ vs Auction RFQ vs secondary vs pre-funded issuance correctly.

tools.name: skew_get_signer_info
tools.description: First tool before any write workflow. Returns the active MCP signer posture: local keypair path/private-key mode, hosted unsigned mode, active profile, visible tool count, and the signer public key when a local write key is configured. Use it to prove which wallet will pay fees and sign transactions; if write_tools_enabled=false, do read-only analysis instead of pretending to trade.

tools.name: skew_get_spot
tools.description: Get the current spot price for a supported asset from Pyth Network (Hermes REST). Returns USD price and confidence interval.

tools.name: skew_get_iv_smile
tools.description: Get the implied-volatility smile for one expiry — IV across a strike ladder, plus 25-delta risk reversal and butterfly. Useful for spotting skew (puts vs calls relative pricing) before you write or buy.

tools.name: skew_get_term_structure
tools.description: Get ATM implied volatility across a standard expiry ladder (7d, 14d, 30d, 60d, 90d, 180d). The shape tells you whether the market expects near-term or far-term volatility — flat = stable, downward-sloping = backwardation = market expects calmer future, upward-sloping = contango.

tools.name: skew_get_volatility_summary
tools.description: Get a one-shot volatility view for an asset — current spot, ATM 30-day IV, smile skew (put vs call), term-structure shape, and a generic vol-view label (stable / elevated / compressing). Designed to answer questions like 'how do you see BTC vol next week?' in a single call.

tools.name: skew_get_fair_value
tools.description: Get a suggested fair-value premium for an option from the Skew pricing service. Returns price in USD plus delta, gamma, vega, theta, rho. Advisory only — the on-chain program does not read this number.

upperBound.description: For range_accrual / capped: upper bound in USD

tools.name: skew_get_margin_breakdown
tools.description: Compute the off-chain clearing-class portfolio-margin breakdown for a candidate options portfolio via the skew-pricing /margin_breakdown endpoint. Launch PM policy (2026-05-08): conservative ConvexHullIM/floor stack, calendar credit disabled, non-vanilla Greek credit audit-gated, and ICC credit applied once under a capped policy. Pass `tier` as the compatibility value: standard=M0 Segregated, silver=M1 Portfolio, gold=M2 Cross-Asset, platinum=M3 Clearing Prime. The response returns a full class ladder for transparency. Advisory-only — the on-chain calculate_margin handler remains the final risk check.

legs.description: Vanilla call/put legs. Each entry: { asset (BTC|ETH|SOL|XRP|HYPE), kind (VanillaCall|VanillaPut), strike, spot, t_years, iv, r (optional, default 0), side (Long|Short), qty }.

regime.description: Regime to drive the per-asset shock and ICC rho matrix. Default Calm. M3 returns both calm and stress IMs side-by-side; lower classes omit regime fields.

tier.description: Clearing-class compatibility value. Default `platinum` maps to M3 Clearing Prime. Lockup schedule: M0 $0, M1 $500K, M2 $2M, M3 $10M (30-day lockup). The full ladder under all 4 classes is returned in `tier_ladder_im_usd` for backward-compatible clients.

tools.name: skew_estimate_fee
tools.description: Compute the launch effective fee for a candidate options trade — VIP volume, clearing-class discount, and optional builder share. Returns effective bps, USD fee, fee-cap state, and the protocol/builder split. Public classes are M0 Segregated, M1 Portfolio, M2 Cross-Asset, and M3 Clearing Prime; compatibility values remain standard/silver/gold/platinum for IDL stability. Builder code share is 25% of effective taker. Spec: docs/fee-schedule-v5.1.md.

volume_30d_usd.description: Caller's 30-day rolling options notional in USD. Drives VIP volume discount resolution.

equity_usd.description: Caller's equity in USD. VIP1 entry path is $25K equity (alternative to volume-based entry). Default 0.

verified_tier.description: Clearing-class compatibility value. Adds 0/10/20/30% taker discount on top of VIP. Maker fee is unaffected by clearing class. Default `standard` = M0.

side.description: Trade side. Default `taker`. Only takers benefit from clearing-class discount.

premium_usd.description: Trade premium in USD. Used to dollarise the fee and check the 12.5%-of-premium fee cap. Default $100 (callers asking for bps only can ignore).

has_builder.description: True if this trade is routed through a registered builder code. When true, the taker fee is split 75% protocol / 25% builder. Default false.

tools.name: skew_fetch_collateral_policy
tools.description: Read the live CollateralPolicyPda mint allowlist for this deployment. Capabilities show protocol support; this tool shows which USDC/wSOL/jitoSOL/custom mints are actually registered now, so agents can preflight before sending write transactions.

tools.name: skew_fetch_pm_cache
tools.description: Read a CM's on-chain PM cache sidecar and return whether cached margin / cached fill can be used. Reports dirty/stale/registry mismatch blockers explicitly. Read-only.

cm_authority.description: CM authority wallet. Defaults to the configured MCP write wallet if omitted.

tools.name: skew_preview_incremental_margin
tools.description: Preview the PM cache envelope for a candidate fill. This is read-only and not an execution guarantee; exact post-fill IM is still produced by relay/SDK transaction preflight.

cm_authority.description: CM authority wallet. Defaults to the configured MCP write wallet if omitted.

estimated_post_im_micro.description: Optional post-fill IM estimate in USDC micro-units. If omitted, the tool returns cache status only.

tools.name: skew_list_rent_reclaimable
tools.description: List owner-first rent reclaim candidates for a wallet. Returns close blockers instead of pretending unsafe accounts can be closed. Read-only.

authority.description: Wallet whose reclaim queue should be scanned. Defaults to the configured MCP write wallet if omitted.

tools.name: skew_list_options
tools.description: List options on Skew devnet, decoded from on-chain `OptionAccount` PDAs. Returns each option's pda, creator, holder, type, state, underlying, direction, strike (USD), upper bound (USD), expiry (unix + ISO), payoff (USD), locked collateral (USD), V0 stamp (USD), σ at creation, and spot at creation. Filters and sort run client-side after the discriminator-filtered scan.

limit.description: Max number of options to return (default 10, max 50).

filter_option_pda.description: Fetch a single option PDA directly. Use this for receipt/readback after a known tx instead of scanning the whole market.

holder.description: Filter by current option holder wallet pubkey.

creator.description: Filter by option creator / writer wallet pubkey.

option_type.description: Filter by anchor `OptionType` storage variant (optional). User-facing payoff names such as `vanilla_call` and `digital_inverse_put` map onto these storage types plus direction.

state.description: Filter by lifecycle state (optional). `Active` = collateralised + bought. `Funded` = collateralised but no buyer yet. `Created` = just minted, no collateral locked.

sort_by.description: Sort order. Default `createdAt` (newest first). `expiry` returns latest expiry first.

tools.name: skew_fetch_portfolio
tools.description: Read a wallet's live Skew portfolio directly from on-chain OptionAccount PDAs. Long side = current holder; short side = creator/writer. Also includes Clearing Member state when registered. Use this after create/buy/transfer to prove the option is visible, not just minted.

owner.description: Wallet pubkey base58. Defaults to configured MCP write wallet. Required when the MCP server is running read-only without a write keypair.

tools.name: skew_list_rfq_auctions
tools.description: List live Auction RFQs from the same public RFQ tape used by the terminal. This discovers auction PDAs before you know their address by merging the indexer view with a bounded on-chain snapshot. Use this before `skew_fetch_rfq_auction`, quote submission, or finalize workflows.

limit.description: Max number of RFQs to return (default 25, max 100).

with_quote.description: Only return RFQs with a currently live best quote.

source.description: Optional source override. Omit for terminal-equivalent indexer plus on-chain snapshot.

tools.name: skew_list_secondary_listings
tools.description: List the public secondary tape from the same listing endpoint used by the terminal. This is discovery/readback only, not an escrowed orderbook. Payment uses skew_buy_secondary_listing and delivery is complete only after seller-side skew_transfer_option returns readback_ok=true.

limit.description: Max number of listings to return (default 25, max 100).

active.description: Return active listings only. Defaults to true.

pending.description: Return listings that are still pending off-chain settlement/indexer confirmation.

seller.description: Filter by listing seller wallet pubkey.

option_pda.description: Filter listings for one option PDA.

exclude_me.description: Exclude listings posted by this seller wallet pubkey.

tools.name: skew_fetch_rfq_auction
tools.description: Read an RfqAuctionPda — buyer, option_spec, max_premium, open/close slots, best_quote (mm + premium + valid_until_slot), state.

tools.name: skew_list_rfq_quotes
tools.description: Read the full quote-depth tape for one RFQ auction PDA from the public web/indexer API. This is read-only and complements skew_fetch_rfq_auction, which only exposes the on-chain best quote snapshot.

limit.description: Maximum quotes to return. Defaults to 50.

tools.name: skew_fetch_clearing_member
tools.description: Read a Clearing Member account snapshot — collateral, IF contribution, clearing-class lockup, total_pm_locked, free_collateral, net notional, last_im_micro, class rank, tier_locked_until, under_liquidation flag. Drives risk diagnostics: equity vs IM ratio (liquidation trigger if < 1.10), class upgrade headroom, free capital for new positions.

cm_authority.description: CM authority pubkey base58. Default: caller's wallet.
